title: The Ceiling on a ShieldCare Food Spoilage Allowance
content:
The ceiling on the allowance for spoiled food under a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan is taken
from the state of the plan's cover and from whether an allowance has lately been paid out as money to
the customer on that plan. The ceiling is never more than the plan's food spoilage cover.

**The cover left on the plan** is the cover credited to it, together with any cover put back at an
anniversary, less the payouts booked against it. An allowance paid out as money to the customer is a payout
on the plan whose settlement took the form of a reimbursement, rather than one settled by repair, by
replacement or by a buyout.

| What the plan shows | The ceiling on the allowance |
| --- | --- |
| the cover left on the plan has fallen below three tenths of the plan's term limit, and an allowance already stands paid out as money to the customer on the plan inside the last 12 months | the ceiling is taken from the cover left on the plan |
| the cover left on the plan has fallen below half the term limit, and no such allowance stands paid inside the last 12 months | the ceiling is half the plan's food spoilage cover |
| every other plan | the ceiling is the plan's food spoilage cover |

### Both sides of the two fractions

Take, as a hypothetical input, a term limit of 8000.00: three tenths of it is 2400.00 and half of it is
4000.00. Cover left of 2399.99 has fallen below three tenths; cover left of exactly 2400.00 has not, and is
tested against the half instead. Cover left of exactly 4000.00 has not fallen below half, so the last row
governs and the ceiling is the plan's food spoilage cover in full.

### Cases on hypothetical figures

Take the same term limit of 8000.00 and, as a further hypothetical input, a food spoilage cover of 260.00.

| Cover left on the plan | An allowance paid out as money inside the last 12 months | The ceiling on the allowance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 5200.00 | none | 260.00, the plan's food spoilage cover |
| 3900.00 | none | 130.00, half the plan's food spoilage cover |
| 3900.00 | one | 260.00, the plan's food spoilage cover |
| 2100.00 | one | 260.00, taken from the cover left and held at the food spoilage cover |
| 180.00 | one | 180.00, taken from the cover left |

The last two lines show the holding at work: the ceiling is taken from the cover left, and where that cover is
the larger figure the ceiling is held at the plan's food spoilage cover instead. The third line shows that an
allowance paid inside the year takes the plan out of the half-cover row.
